title: Amtrak records 205 of 385 active stations at substantial completion
summary: Amtrak reports 205 of 385 active stations reached substantial completion: 159 with full Amtrak responsibility met and 46 complete except for platforms outside Amtrak's responsibility. Denominator: Amtrak's 385 active-station ADA program denominator, split into 159 full-responsibility completions, 46 platform-excluded completions, and 180 stations not represented as substantially complete.
